messages.subject: renderUI suddenly stopped working
parts:
Hi All

ui code:
column(width =6,

                           uiOutput("topic_no_select")

                       )

server code:

## Topic number output
  output$topic_no_select <- renderUI({
    if(input$Vis_level_select == "Main Topics"){
      selectInput(inputId = "main_topic_no", label = "", choices = "N/A", selected = "N/A")
    } else{
      selectInput(inputId = "main_topic_no", label = "", choices = c(1:10), selected = 1)
    }
  })
  
  ## LDAvis output
  output$LDAvis_output <- renderVis({
    if(input$Vis_level_select == "Sub-Topics"){
     viz_file <- paste0("Viz_Sub_topics_Main_Topic_",input$main_topic_no)
    } else if(input$Vis_level_select == "Main Topics"){
      viz_file <- "Viz_Sub_topics_Main_Topics"
    }
    get(viz_file)
  })



The if statement in LDAvis output gives me blank and it gives me an error saying that "Viz_Sub_topics_Main_Topic_" not found. Once I change the value of input$Vis_level_select then the first part of LDAvis works but still the second part is not working. I am unable to understand why this is happening.

Please let me know if this is just a bug that will go away on restarting.
